$comment: The fate of EVERY top-level key of model.schema.json. Machine-readable twin of CONCEPT_MAP.md. tools/concept_map_check.py fails when a schema key is missing here or a key here is missing from the schema. 'noun' is one of the 12 nouns of the final vocabulary; every other key must name the noun it belongs to. Phase = the TASKS.md phase that executes the fate.

nouns.oneLine: A kind of record the app stores: fields, lifecycle, invariants, who may read/write it.
A named, parameterised, permission-aware read over one concept (filters, joins, groupBy).
Something the app DOES: a list of steps started by a trigger (api, ui, event, schedule, webhook, internal call).
A named fact that happened, with a payload; flows emit it and flows can be triggered by it or await it.
NEW. A named, pure, typed computation callable from any expression (stdlib, pack-provided, or code extension).
A door to the outside world: outbound operations (HTTP API, payments, code extension) or inbound webhooks.
A kind of user, and what that kind may do on which concepts and flows.
NEW. What one or more roles see: home, navigation, screens, device (web/mobile).
One page of an experience, of a closed archetype (list, detail, form, board, map, inbox, dashboard, workbench, document, picker, custom).
A versioned library of the nouns above, installed from somewhere else.
A boundary INSIDE one project (today: contexts[]); imports are explicit and acyclic.
A runtime setting resolved through scopes (app, tenant, user ...), changeable without regenerating.

keys.decision: MERGE: an aggregate has no identity apart from its root concept (one mandatory root; every corpus aggregate is named == root or <Root>Aggregate), so it becomes a composition part of that Concept and its UI half becomes Screen kind=workbench; nothing at runtime is lost provided the three by-name references (autoPanels[].aggregate, documents[].aggregate, agentAccess exposures[].aggregate) and the runtime URL /api/v1/runtime/aggregate/{name} are re-pointed to the root concept name and the validator enforces one composition per concept.
evidence: NPDevContract/dsl/src/main/java/com/npdev/dsl/v1/ast/AggregateAst.java:13-25 - an aggregate is exactly {name, root (one concept), collections[], onCommit, onValidate, invariants[], balances[], metadata}: no state of its own, everything hangs off one root concept

NPDevContract/dsl/src/main/java/com/npdev/dsl/v1/ast/AggregateCollectionAst.java:17-27 - owned collection = {name, concept, childField, ownership, orderBy, nested collections, lookupFields}: maps 1:1 to a concept-level owned-collections list

NPDevContract/dsl/src/main/java/com/npdev/dsl/v1/compiler/ModelCompiler.java:654-664 - the only compile-time consumer that turns an aggregate into UI is an aggregate-bound autoPanel -> AutoPanelExpander.expandAggregateWorkbench (NPDevContract/dsl/src/main/java/com/npdev/dsl/v1/compiler/AutoPanelExpander.java:104-132): this is the Screen kind=workbench half

NPDevRuntimeHost/runtimehost-core/src/main/java/com/finalexec/npdev/service/AggregateRuntime.java:174,219,323,368,724 - load/commit/invoke/checkBalances/assertAggregateInvariants are keyed by aggregate NAME and run on the root + collections draft tree; the semantics survive if the key becomes the root concept name

NPDevContract/dsl/src/main/java/com/npdev/dsl/v1/validation/AggregateValidation.java:366-377 - `ownership` (owned|referenced) is validated and used only for the owned-cycle guard; grep of .ownership() in src/main finds no runtime reader (only ModelCompiler.java:1405 and CompiledModelCanonicalJson.java:964 copy it) -> effectively documentation, can be dropped

NPDevContract/dsl/src/main/java/com/npdev/dsl/v1/parser/JsonModelParser.java:1166,1553 and NPDevContract/dsl/src/main/java/com/npdev/dsl/v1/ast/AutoPanelAst.java:18 - three other constructs reference an aggregate by name (agentAccess exposure, documents[], autoPanels[]): the re-pointing work list

NPDevContract/dsl/src/main/java/com/npdev/dsl/v1/ast/AggregateInvariantAst.java:3-15 - aggregate invariants are CROSS-collection (evaluated against the whole draft tree), unlike ConceptAst invariants which are single-record

docs/adr/ADR-0004-aggregate-workbench.md:44-52 (L1) - the ADR itself defines the aggregate as a root concept plus owned child collections; its implementation note (lines 7-14) says some sketched names never shipped, the decision stands

Corpus (8 models, 20 aggregates): NPDevSamples/dsl-conformance-max/Input/model.json:1406 (3), NPDevSamples/f6-showcase/Input/model.json (1), NPDevSamples/pigmentampas/Input/model.json (2), AppGen/apps/_official/WmsOffice/definition/model.json (6), AppGen/apps/_experiments/WmsOfficePackTest/definition/model.json (6), docwire-r57-proof, payment-webhook-rehearsal, simple-product-h2local (1 each); plus pack.json of dom-sales/purchasing/inventory/leave/helpdesk and labeling. keys.decision: OWNER 2026-11-15: fold into experiences[].locale and experiences[].strings (P5) - the top-level key goes away. Reasoning kept from P2-T1: (per-app locale + string catalogue): settings IS read - locale and strings drive the generated UI catalogue and platform labels. Do NOT move to properties[]/config.json (generation-time, baked into the bundle; a Property is runtime-resolved).
